messages:
Anya R: quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / sample app checks
Anya R: yesterday: landed the node SDK docs update (auth section) and pushed a small fix to the python quickstart that caused the example to fail with v0.9.7
Anya R: blocker: CI flaky on macOS wheels for the sampleapp, seeing a sporadic segfault in the wasm-ext step. haven’t traced root cause yet.
Anya R: today: triage the macOS CI flakes, follow up with infra on reproducer, and draft a tiny note for the quickstart that warns about the mac homebrew tls oddity
Matt C: noted — thanks! i glanced at the segfault in the logs last night, seems tied to lto+wheel build flags. can you paste the failing command?
Anya R: sure — the failing command is: `python -m build --wheel --outdir dist/` then `pip install dist/redwood_sampleapp-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl` and the segfault happens during `import redwood` on CI
Matt C: ok i’ll try locally with the same build flags on my mac mini (arm64), might be M1 vs M2 differences
Jordan H: small heads-up: i pushed a sampleapp tweak that uses streaming for chat responses — changed the Node quickstart to show `client.streamResponses(...)` example. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/218
Sophie L: thanks Jordan — can we also add a note in the quickstart about enabling `stream:true` in the console for hosted users? i had a support ticket where the user missed that setting and thought streaming was broken
Jordan H: good call. i’ll add a one-liner in the Node quickstart and the FAQ section of the docs
Lia (devex-bot): reminder: docs-lint job failed on docs PR #482 — missing codeblock language on the embedding quickstart snippet
Anya R: ack, will fix. which snippet? the `embed()` example?
Lia (devex-bot): yes — the python embed example in /docs/quickstarts/embeddings.md
Anya R: ok i’ll push a one-line fix to add ```python
Matt C: quick code review ping: @Anya R can you also bump the sampleapp's dev-deps to the latest redwood-sdk pre-release? the sample CI uses pinned older sdk and that could hide regressions
Anya R: will do — plan: bump -> run sampleapp unit tests locally -> open PR. ETA: EOD PST
Jordan H: small question on rollout docs: do we want to document the 'fallback to cheaper model' policy in the quickstarts or keep that in runtime/ops docs? i can see both sides
Sophie L: i'd prefer mention in quickstarts as a callout: "hosted may fall back to compatible model variants under capacity constraints" (1 line) and link to rollout policy for details
Jordan H: cool, i’ll draft that blurb and put it in the quickstarts PR
Anya R: blockers summary: macOS CI segfault (investigating), docs-lint missing language tag (fix queued). otherwise unblocked
Matt C: i’ll try reproduce for segfault and report back. if i can reproduce, i'll open a tiny repro repo
Sophie L: FYI — support ticket #3421 about streaming now has the streaming note i added to the ticket thread. low priority but good to close after quickstart update
Jordan H: for the sampleapp streaming example, do we want a minimal snippet showing server-side chunk handling? i can add a 6-line example to keep it tiny
Anya R: yes please, keep it compact. include a code comment about chunk boundaries and token limits
Matt C: one more thing — headroom check for docs: can someone take the docs console screenshots? i’m booked this afternoon. need screenshots for the streaming toggle and the rollout page
Sophie L: i can grab screenshots after standup, should be able to upload to the PR
Anya R: sweet, thanks. if anyone gets a repro for mac segfault DM me so we can coordinate a hotfix PR
Jordan H: nice work team, tiny follow-ups and we’re good
Lia (devex-bot): FYI scheduled task: docs-build nightly at 02:00 UTC will run after Anya's PR lands — expect rebuilds
Matt C: noted. pinging infra if we need a special mac runner for reproducer
Sophie L: done — added the screenshots to the quickstart PR draft and left a TODO to add the fallback blurb
Anya R: wrap-up: i'll open two PRs (1) quickstart fix + language tag + small note, (2) sampleapp bump + unit test run. will update thread when PRs are up. thanks :sparkles:
